$comment: Phase 11 (0.0.28) Task 0 public API freeze manifest. Machine-checkable source of truth consumed by Tasks 1-6: every new export name, subpath, cap (default/hard), p95 ceiling, placement decision, and security invariant must match this file exactly. Amendment requires a recorded Task 0 freeze amendment in plans/011. Validated by scripts/phase11-freeze.test.mjs.

placement.$comment: Adapter-over-primitives confirmed: every adapter composes existing IdentityVerifier, PolicyEvaluator/evaluateAndAppend, OAuthProvider/OAuthCredentialStore, credential resolver chain, SsrfPolicy (assertSsrfAllowedUrl, src/content.ts), SecretRedactor, MCP bridge/server limits, ArtifactService, and PersistenceLifecycleStore (legal hold + retention). Core gains only the ArtifactBodyStore contract (proven missing: metadata lives in checkpoints, bodies never do).
placement.decision: Four placements: (1) OIDC verifier as @arnilo/prism-credentials-node/oidc subpath (Node-only network adapter; reuses limits/errors/redaction patterns). (2) OPA evaluator as @arnilo/prism-policy/opa subpath (recorded through existing evaluateAndAppend durable ledger; enterprise-postgres createPostgresPolicyDecisionStore unchanged). (3) MCP OAuth extends @arnilo/prism-mcp (client auth option on connectMcpTools/attachMcpToolBridge; server protected-resource metadata; reuse @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0 client/auth.js + server/auth OAuthServerProvider). (4) OpenAPI tools as new minimal package @arnilo/prism-openapi-tools (work-tools and web-tools are vendor-connector scoped: Google/M365 and Brave/Exa/Firecrawl; core stays network-free). Artifact blob contract goes to core src/artifacts.ts; reference S3 adapter as @arnilo/prism-server/artifact-bodies subpath.

newPackages.name: @arnilo/prism-openapi-tools
newPackages.budget: packed-bytes baseline measured and recorded in scripts/budgets.json phase11 section at Task 6 (requires built package); budget-gate entry added there

@arnilo/prism-credentials-node/oidc.reusedSeams: IdentityVerifier, AgentIdentity, IdentityError (reasons frozen below), resolveIdentityLimits (maxScopes 64/256, maxScopeBytes 128/512, maxMetadataBytes 4/16 KiB, maxCredentialRefBytes 256/2 KiB, maxPrincipalIdBytes 256/2 KiB), SsrfPolicy via assertSsrfAllowedUrl on pinned jwksUrl

@arnilo/prism-policy/opa.reusedSeams: PolicyEvaluator, PolicyEvaluateRequest/Result, evaluateAndAppend, createPostgresPolicyDecisionStore (durable Phase 6 ledger), PolicyLimits (decision 8/64 KiB, reason/evidence ref 1/8 KiB)

@arnilo/prism-mcp.reusedSeams: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0 client/auth.js (auth, OAuthClientProvider, discoverOAuthProtectedResourceMetadata, discoverAuthorizationServerMetadata, discoverOAuthServerInfo, startAuthorization, prepareAuthorizationCodeRequest, selectResourceURL, extractWWWAuthenticateParams, OAuthDiscoveryState) and server/auth (OAuthServerProvider, OAuthTokenVerifier, AuthInfo); createOAuthCredentialStoreAdapter + createOAuth2PkceVerifier/computeOAuth2S256Challenge from credentials-node; assertSsrfAllowedUrl
@arnilo/prism-mcp.clientAuthStrategy: host-chosen: static client credentials or RFC 7591 DCR callback (registerClient). Token audience binding via RFC 8707 resource parameter + selectResourceURL; tokens never sent to a different origin.

@arnilo/prism-openapi-tools.reusedSeams: ToolDefinition, ToolResult, ToolExecutionContext, SecretRedactor, approval + idempotency metadata (Phase 7/8 tool effect contracts)

@arnilo/prism.coreContract: ArtifactBodyStore (put/get/delete/presign by opaque reference, ownership-scoped) + ArtifactBodyRef, ArtifactBodyStoreError, ARTIFACT_BODY_* constants in src/artifacts.ts; types only, storage-free
@arnilo/prism.reusedSeams: ArtifactRecord/ArtifactDeliveryToken, PersistenceLifecycleStore legal hold + retention sweep, OwnershipScope

@arnilo/prism-server/artifact-bodies.reusedSeams: createArtifactService options gain optional bodies: ArtifactBodyStore; delivery links resolve through bodies.presign

objectStore.selection: S3-compatible object store (AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2) as the single reference adapter; host contract via ArtifactBodyStore covers other stores.
objectStore.signing: Hand-rolled SigV4 presigning over native fetch + WebCrypto (crypto.subtle). Single-chunk presigned PUT/GET with exact Content-Length and x-amz-content-sha256 = verified SHA-256 hex (size + hash already verified before upload, so no chunked transfer needed). Path-style addressing; no accelerate endpoints. @aws-sdk/client-s3 rejected at freeze: ~1 MB install, license/SBOM surface, and the presign edge cases it covers (chunked upload, accelerate) are excluded by the single-chunk design.
objectStore.encryption: Host-owned client-side encryption/KMS callback (kms?: (op: 'encrypt'|'decrypt', body: Uint8Array) => Promise<Uint8Array>) mirroring credentials-node HostKms envelope pattern; never inline keys.
objectStore.retention: delete refuses while resource under legal hold (isResourceHeld / PersistenceLifecycleStore); retention sweep deletes bodies with metadata; body delete is idempotent.

caps.$comment: default/hard pairs. Existing frozen caps are reused where they already cover the surface (no duplicate knobs); reuse entries name the source.

algorithms.hard: host may only narrow, never widen

maxRedirects.notes: discovery/token endpoints never redirect; exact-origin compare

p95Targets.$comment: Ceilings for network-free fake-server fixtures (fake OIDC provider, fake OPA, fake authorization server, hostile OpenAPI origin, fake object store). Machine-dependent; recorded as evidence by scripts/phase11-conformance.test.mjs (Task 6) into scripts/budgets.json phase11 section. Existing benchmarkMedians tolerance 0.25 unchanged.

securityInvariants.oidc: Fail closed on unknown issuer/audience/algorithm/key; alg:none and non-allowlisted algorithms rejected; exp/nbf with bounded clock skew; unknown kid triggers exactly one bounded JWKS refetch then failure; JWKS URL host-pinned and SSRF-checked (assertSsrfAllowedUrl); oversized claims fail closed; tokens/claims never logged; IdentityError messages carry no token material; revocation callback error fails closed.
securityInvariants.policy: Policy endpoint URL host-pinned and SSRF-checked; raw prompts/tool args/JWTs never enter the OPA input document; credential values never in input; timeout/malformed/oversized/stale-version responses fail closed (default outcome deny); decision recorded through existing redacted durable ledger.
securityInvariants.mcpOauth: Tokens are bound to the resource they were issued for (RFC 8707 + selectResourceURL); sending a token to a different origin/audience refused (confused-deputy denial); zero redirects on discovery/token endpoints; SSRF policy on every discovery endpoint; https-only except explicit host loopback-http opt-in; tokens never enter prompts, telemetry, persisted discovery records, or errors; refresh tokens only in credentials-node encrypted/keychain stores.
securityInvariants.openapi: Only host-listed operationIds compile; server origin pinned (servers-array drift rejected); schema refs/cycles/size bounded; no raw method/path passthrough; responses treated as untrusted (redaction + bounds before context); side-effect tools carry approval + idempotency metadata; credentials only via host resolver callback.
securityInvariants.artifacts: Ownership/tenant verified on every read/delete; upload hash/size/MIME mismatch fails closed; legal hold blocks delete (hold wins over retention); credentials only via host resolver; bucket/path/key never disclosed in errors, telemetry, or artifact records; presigned URLs bounded TTL and scope.

testFixtures.oidcCases: valid RS256/ES256; expired; future nbf; wrong issuer/audience; alg:none + non-allowlisted; unknown-kid rotation (refetch once then fail); JWKS outage warm/cold cache; JWKS cache poisoning; oversized claims; revocation true/false/throw; tenant mapping without tenantId; cache-hit/miss p95
testFixtures.policyCases: allow/deny/modify/approval mapping; malformed/oversized/timeout; stale version; evidence bounds; fail-closed default vs escalate; durable ledger row (memory + postgres store); credentials-not-in-input
testFixtures.mcpOauthCases: metadata discovery via WWW-Authenticate + well-known; PKCE/state round trip; scope challenge; refresh; revocation; audience mismatch denial; confused-deputy passthrough denial; SSRF private-IP metadata; redirect policy; exact origin; discovery cache TTL/poisoning; DCR success/denial; server metadata shape
testFixtures.openapiCases: operation allow-list; server override denial; ref/cycle/size hostile docs; pagination/retry bounds; side-effect approval + idempotency; credential/redaction in output; hostile response bodies
testFixtures.artifactCases: put/get/delete; hash/size/MIME mismatch; wrong tenant; legal hold blocks delete; retention sweep; signed link expiry; encryption callback; partial-failure rollback; object-store outage; presign tamper; concurrency caps
